description: Waits until a session has no running or queued turn and returns the last turn's result: the same JSON as run_thronglet, or its error. With timeout_s elapsed returns {session_id, state, queued} instead. Idempotent: the result is stored with the session.

timeout_s.description: How long to wait in seconds; default from config (21600). Elapsed → the session state, not an error

name: wait_thronglet
